description: This Java class 'ShoppingCartServiceImpl' provides implementation for shopping cart services in an e-commerce platform. It includes functionalities such as retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, merging shopping carts, populating cart items, and generating shipping products.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of shopping cart service handling retrieval, creation, update, and merging of shopping carts in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieve a shopping cart for a specific customer, populating its items and checking obsolescence.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new shopping cart or update an existing one.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Get a shopping cart by its ID with optional store context, populating its data.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a shopping cart based on its code and associated merchant store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Get a shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: populateShoppingCart
methods.description: Populate shopping cart with current item details, resolving obsolescence.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Create and populate a shopping cart item from a product, including pricing and attributes.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Generate shipping product details for a shopping cart.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Determine if the shopping cart is free (total price zero) based on its items.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Check if any item in the cart requires shipping.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Remove the shopping cart from the database.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merge a session shopping cart with a user's existing shopping cart, combining items.
